out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: brown cinnamon butter on the prep line was 70º. This product is made from unsalted butter, as such it must be kept cold or hot, or on time as a public health control procedure.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The brown butter was prepared approximately one hour ago. The PIC was advised to discard it after three more hours. The PIC also requested to put the product on time as a public health control procedure. The document was created during today’s visit and entered into the establishment record.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. The 2025 permit is posted.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Post the 2026 permit as soon as possible.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed a server using the handsink at the drink station to rinse out equipment.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. The EHS discussed this with the food manager.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Food Contact with Equipment & Utensils
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found stored in contact with soiled equipment or utensils: a bottle of whipped cream was stored in cut lettuce in one the prep refrigerator at the salad station.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall only contact surfaces of equipment and utensils that are cleaned and sanitized or the food shall be in contact with only single-service items. the manager removed the whipped cream and discarded the lettuce.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: French onion soup on the hot line was 122ºF.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The soup was reheated to 165ºF. CDI. TED'S BULLETIN MERRIFIELD (Inspection Date: 01/05/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: diced tomatoes and aiolie sauce in the saute unit were 44º and 45º, respectively. Quinoa was 72º F on the table top.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The products were discarded. CDI.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: egg mix, raw shell eggs, and potatoes on time as a public health control were not time marked as required.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. The products were discarded, per the conditions of using time as a public health control. CDI.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device in several refrigerators including the 6 drawer prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Ensure all refrigerators have thermometers in them as soon as possible or before the next inspection

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. One food employee was wearing bracelets on their wrist while preparing food behind the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. The EHS discussed this issue with the general manager, who discussed it with food staff.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. One food employee working on the cook line was not wearing a hair restraint while preparing foods.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. The food employee put on hat during the inspection after the EHS discussed this with the manager. TED'S BULLETIN MERRIFIELD (Inspection Date: 01/05/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. A wet wiping cloth was stored on the counter and not in the sanitizer bucket provided.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The cloth was placed in the provided sanitizer bucket.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: An in-use cutting board used to cut steaks from the grill is placed directly in front of a handwashing sink near the sauté station, which will lead to contamination when employees wash their hands.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation in-utensils and equipment such as this cutting board should not be stored where they are exposed to splash, especially directly in front of a handwashing sink where food employees are washing their soiled hands which can lead to cross contamination of the cutting board and the foods cut on it. The EHS discussed this issue with the general manager who said he would relocate the cutting board to a different location away from the hand sink. Also, since the cutting board is a food equipment, it must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use, or every four hours. Please ensure this.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling diffusers at the kitchen entrance were very dusty and in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS gave PIC a copy of the vomit and diarrhea cleanup poster.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: Hollandaise sauce
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC marked container of hollandaise sauce with an end point.

out_items.name: Food additives; approved and properly used

violations.title: Approved Additives
violations.observation: Food offered for service or sale contains the following unapproved food additives or additives at unapproved levels: BEE POLLEN is being offered as a garnish for cocktails
violations.corrective_action: Food may not contain unapproved food additives or additives that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 170-180 relating to food additives, generally recognized as safe or prior sanctioned substances that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 181-186, substances that exceed amounts specified in 9 CFR Subpart C Section 424.21(b) Food ingredients and sources of radiation, or pesticide residues that exceed provisions specified in 40 CFR 180 Tolerances for pesticides chemicals in food, and exceptions. EHS informed PIC that BEE POLLEN is an unapproved additive, PIC disposed of BEE POLLEN and agreed to stop use of BEE POLLEN until further notice. TED'S BULLETIN MERRIFIELD (Inspection Date: 07/09/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. RAID was observed on the cookline
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC disposed of RAID.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 3 door under counter cooler by the walk in cooler, 3x2 drawer prep top cooler on the cookline, 3 door under counter cooler on the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC found and replace the thermometers in the coolers.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed ponding of water in the 3 compartment sink and 3 vat sink dishwashing area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS asked PIC to clean the drains so the water on the floor of the kitchen would stop ponding.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: EHS observed ventilations system in the kitchen area are in need of cleaning ( dust build up)
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS asked PIC to clean the ventilation system

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: 3 knives stored in knives rack at prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. Items were removed to be washed and sanitized.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): PIC was not able to locate written TPHC procedures.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. Procedures were written during inspection for potatoes, egg mix, whole shell eggs.
